queries_run: AbbVie Skyrizi Rinvoq competition oral IL-23 icotrokinra threat 2026

findings.claim: AbbVie 10-K 列明免疫產品與 IL-23、IL-17、JAK 抑制劑及生物類似藥競爭，腫瘤產品與 BTK、ADC、細胞療法競爭；新產品與醫療實務改變可能導致產品過時。
findings.excerpt: AbbVie's immunology products compete with IL-23 inhibitors, IL-17 inhibitors, JAK inhibitors, biosimilars and other competitive products intended to treat a number of disease states, and AbbVie's oncology products compete with targeted therapies including BTK inhibitors, ADCs, cell therapies and other competitive products intended to treat certain cancers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：專利到期後學名藥/生物類似藥會在短時間內顯著壓低銷售。
findings.excerpt: The expiration or loss of patent protection for a product typically is followed promptly by substitutes that may significantly reduce sales for that product in a short amount of time.

findings.claim: FDA 於 2026-03-18 核准 J&J 口服 IL-23 受體拮抗劑 icotrokinra（Icotyde）用於中重度斑塊型乾癬，被定位為 Skyrizi 的直接競爭者；搜尋摘要稱 AbbVie 管理層表示 Icotyde 上市後 Skyrizi 新患與轉換新處方仍成長，並上調 2026 年 Skyrizi 至 216 億、Rinvoq 至 102 億美元。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要（引 S&P Global Market Intelligence、Fierce Pharma 等）

note: 僅搜尋1次；Icotyde 一條為摘要轉述、未核原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
